HexPlayer

an accessibile youtube browser for screen reader users
HexPlayer 5.3.1 — hotfix: double-clicking the app now opens the GUI again. The 5.3.0 command-line tool was installed under a name that collided with the main HexPlayer.exe on Windows and replaced it, so launching the app opened a terminal instead of the interface. The CLI is now named hexplayer-cli and no longer overwrites the GUI.
